snippet.title: Camping Resort Simulator – Official Trailer | Free Demo October 1 on Steam
snippet.description:
Take a wild stretch of coast and turn it into a place people come back to. 🏕️🌴

Camping Resort Simulator is a cozy management game on Steam: shape a real place on the coast, build pitches, glamping tents, bungalows, villas, a pool and a beach club, then watch every guest live their own holiday, from lazy afternoons to summer nights.

🎮 Free demo on Steam: October 1
🎪 Steam Next Fest: October 19–26
⭐ Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952320/Camping_Resort_Simulator/
